metadata.recipe: stage h = 1 + 19 r1; log10 discharge = log10(sum over active controls of alpha_k (h - h_k)^beta_k) + 0.05 * PhiInverse(r2); r1 and r2 are the workbook's stored uniform draws; 300 daily observations from 2000-01-01
metadata.seed: workbook uniform draws r1 and r2; no runtime random sampling
metadata.parameter_layout: [h1, log10 alpha1, beta1, (h2, log10 alpha2, beta2, (h3, log10 alpha3, beta3,)) sigma]
metadata.example_project_analysis_settings: UseDefaultFlatPriors=true, UseJeffreysRuleForScale=true, production BayesianAnalysis defaults (DEMCzs, seed 12345, 3500 iterations, 1750 warmup, 90% interval, posterior mean)
metadata.oracle: per-observation log-space Gaussian terms (RC.4), base-10 change-of-variables terms log(Q ln 10), and SciPy lognorm(s = sigma ln 10, scale = predicted discharge) discharge-space terms (RC.5)
